text: Recommends Mermaid over Excalidraw for this case, given inline GitHub markdown rendering and text-diffable editing in pull requests
Names GitHub-native rendering as the deciding factor, since an .excalidraw file does not render inline in a markdown file
Names reviewability or diffability in pull requests as a reason, since Excalidraw JSON is not meaningfully reviewable in a diff
Notes that Excalidraw JSON is verbose for a three-node diagram
Still delivers a working diagram rather than only refusing, providing the Mermaid version ready to paste
The delivered diagram is in a fenced code block tagged mermaid
States the condition under which Excalidraw would be the right pick instead, for example presentation decks or hand-drawn architecture overviews
